claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_temperature_protection
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's second rider grants deterministic protection from extreme environmental cold to the wearer and carried/worn gear. That is not typed damage reduction, resistance, or damage immunity, and the current surface has no atom for environmental temperature protection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower
